tests.name: real Hyprland session and fixed tool prerequisites
cold diagnostic probe succeeds with the screenshot provider disabled
owned fixture is placed on the actual fractional-scale output when present
reliable AT-SPI bounds drive click, double-click, long press and modifiers
GTK exports real controls and receives semantic Chinese/Unicode writes
Electron invoke and Chinese/Unicode text replacement reach the real application
keyboard and mouse down persist until explicit up, including intervening observation
scroll and timed drag produce application-visible wheel/motion effects
global logical pointer actions reach the same fixture at the observed output scale
keyboard/clipboard Unicode input preserves the requested content
popup controls are reobserved and semantically operated
rebuilt controls reject their old object references
window move/resize invalidates coordinate observations
same-title same-PID windows do not silently select a sibling, and focus is reread
cancelled queued input never reaches the desktop
a partial batch preserves the first input and stops after geometry changes
cancel during a real held press releases input without replay
timeout during a real held press releases input without replay
unexpected worker exit releases owned held keys and invalidates old references
application restart invalidates old window and control identities
the complete cold-start workflow made zero capture/OCR/legacy-backend calls
an optional capture_after failure preserves an already-executed input
the real desktop includes a fractional-scale output
